props.title: What Is a Manicure and Pedicure?
props.text: A manicure and pedicure is nail care for your hands and feet: trimming, shaping, cuticle care and moisturising, finished with polish or gel if you like. A manicure or a pedicure takes about 30 minutes; both together take about an hour.
props.feature1Text: Professional care helps maintain clean, tidy, and well-shaped nails.
props.feature2Text: Hydration and conditioning leave hands and feet feeling smoother.

props.title: Manicure & Pedicure Packages in Seminyak
props.text: Each package pairs a manicure and pedicure with a Balinese massage, a cream bath or a Bali Moon Facial, or two of these.

items.question: What is included in a manicure and pedicure?
items.answer: A manicure and pedicure at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak includes nail trimming, shaping, cuticle care and moisturising, starting with a consultation and nail assessment. Nail colour or gel is optional, depending on the service you choose. Both together cost IDR 238.000 per person, or IDR 99.000 for a manicure and IDR 139.000 for a pedicure.

items.question: What is the difference between a manicure and a pedicure?
items.answer: A manicure focuses on the hands and fingernails, while a pedicure treats the feet, toenails and areas such as the heels and cuticles. You can have either, or both, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.

items.question: How often should I have a manicure and pedicure?
items.answer: Many guests book a manicure and pedicure every two to three weeks, although the ideal schedule depends on nail growth and personal preference. Gel nails give a longer-lasting finish.

items.question: Can I choose gel nails instead of regular polish?
items.answer: Yes. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, gel nail application is available as a separate treatment for guests who prefer a longer-lasting finish. Gel costs IDR 219.000 per person for hands or feet, or IDR 438.000 for both, while regular nail colour is IDR 69.000 for hands or feet.

items.question: Can I have a manicure and pedicure at my villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. A Spa Bali Moon therapist comes to your villa or hotel with everything a manicure and pedicure needs. You pay the spa price (IDR 99.000 for a manicure, IDR 139.000 for a pedicure or IDR 238.000 for both, per person) plus a home service fee of IDR 75.000 per therapist in Seminyak, Petitenget and Kerobokan, or IDR 150.000 in Canggu, North Kuta and Kuta.

items.question: How much does a manicure and pedicure cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: A manicure and pedicure at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak costs IDR 238.000 per person, or IDR 99.000 for a manicure and IDR 139.000 for a pedicure. Nail colour is from IDR 69.000 and gel from IDR 219.000. Home service adds IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area. Packages from IDR 375.000 per person add a cream bath, massage or facial.

items.question: How long does a manicure and pedicure take?
items.answer: A manicure or a pedicure at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak takes about 30 minutes, and both together about an hour. A manicure is IDR 99.000, a pedicure IDR 139.000 and both IDR 238.000 per person.

items.question: Can I ask for a female or male therapist for my manicure and pedicure?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your preference when you book your manicure and pedicure on WhatsApp and we'll arrange a female or male therapist, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.

props.title: Keep Your Hands and Feet Looking Their Best
props.text: Well-groomed nails are about comfort as much as appearance. Professional manicure and pedicure care in a calm setting, at our spa or at your villa or hotel.
props.closingText: Reserve your manicure and pedicure and leave with neat, polished nails.
